On Monday, a new student came to Green School. Her first name was Anna, and her surname was Wu. She was from China. At the gate, a friendly teacher said, “Hello, Anna. I am Ms Green. Are you in Class 4?” Anna was happy. “Yes, I am,” she said. Two students, Mia and Tom, showed Anna their classroom. Mia said, “This is my desk. That is Tom’s desk.” At break, they met Anna’s cousin, Ben. He was a student too. “My family lives near the school,” Anna said. When the bell rang, the children went inside. “Thank you for helping me,” Anna said. “You are welcome,” said Mia.
